source: Official artwork as archived by PidgiWiki (pidgi.net), loaded at runtime from its image CDN (cdn.pidgi.net) as 400px-wide copies, not bundled; © Nintendo / Creatures / GAME FREAK. Checked on 2026-10-04 that each loads when requested from another site (scripts/check-trainer-sprites.mjs checks them too). Shown on the opponent card only; battles keep the Showdown trainer sprite.
notes: Only special trainers and the Battle Legends have entries: Sun & Moon has no official 2D artwork for regular trainer classes (only in-game 3D 'VS' model renders, hosted by the Bulbagarden Archives, which blocks embedding on other sites).
Not from the Pokémon Wiki (Fandom) or the Bulbagarden Archives: both block images from being shown on other sites.
Cynthia and Wally appear in Sun & Moon in their Diamond and Pearl / Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire designs (matching their Showdown sprites), so that art is used.
Trainers without usable art fall back to the enlarged Showdown sprite (see 'missing').

missing.Grimsley: Sun & Moon artwork (new outfit) is only on the Bulbagarden Archives, which blocks embedding; other hosts only have his Black and White design.
missing.Anabel: No embeddable official art of her Sun & Moon design (only Emerald and Pokémon Masters art).
missing.Colress: No official art of his Sun & Moon design (only Black 2 and White 2 art and concept sketches).
missing.Sina: No official art of her Sun & Moon (Alola) outfit; only concept sketches.
missing.Dexio: No official art of his Sun & Moon (Alola) outfit; only an in-game model render and concept sketches.
